set.body: Cross-reference ephys4s Mote ephys4s-provider-intaglio-boundary-root. At aad4e0e25bc5c20af8158131d04a757b1e894a1a, invoking coreJVM/test through a source consumer causes five ModuleBoundarySuite checks to inspect the consumer source tree because root is found from user.dir. Reproduction and preserved failure: ephys4s/docs/verification/native-tranche-2026-10-21/providers/native-2.log. Expected: bind source inspection to the suite owning checkout without changing global user.dir or skipping boundary guards. Acceptance: regression plus complete core suite from provider root and source consumer root, formatter, exact commands/outcomes, canonical integration before downstream pin update. Branch fix/module-boundary-source-root.
set.title: Bind boundary tests to the owning source checkout under ProjectRef consumers
